debug.title: Enable SSH access
debug.description: Start an sshd inside the run and expose it over this run's container URL (SSH-over-WebSocket). The run log then prints the exact ~/.ssh/config block to paste. Never enable on production runs.

sshPublicKey.title: Your SSH public key
sshPublicKey.description: Required when debug is on. One OpenSSH public key line, e.g. the contents of ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub. This is the only credential that grants the session - password login is off.

waitForConnection.title: Block until you connect
waitForConnection.description: With debug on, pause before counting until an SSH session attaches (no timeout - the run timeout is the safety net; abort the run if you change your mind). Turn off to start counting immediately and connect mid-run.
